about.title: About us
about.body1: Awenda Jewelry is a small, family-run jewelry business. Every piece starts at our weekly market stand and now finds a home online too.
about.body2: We're still writing our full story here — check back soon, or say hello at the market.

policies.title: Policies
policies.shippingBody: We ship within Canada with one flat rate. Full shipping details are coming soon.
policies.returnsBody: Our return and exchange policy is being finalized. In the meantime, contact us and we'll sort it out.
policies.privacyBody: We collect only what's needed to fulfill your order and to understand how the shop is used. We don't use cookies for tracking, so there is no cookie banner.
policies.privacyAnalyticsBody: We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits, pages and countries. It is cookieless and does not track you across sites or identify you personally.
policies.privacyEventsBody: To see which designs people look at, we record a few anonymous events on our own servers: pages viewed, designs viewed, items added to the cart and checkouts started. Each event carries a random ID that lives only in your browser tab, your language, whether you're on mobile or desktop, and the website you came from. It holds no name, email or IP address, and events are deleted after 13 months.
policies.privacyEmailsBody: If you place an order, we use your details only to process it. If you ask to be notified when a design is back in stock, or subscribe to our newsletter, we store your email address only for that purpose. We never sell it or share it.
policies.privacyUnsubscribeBody: Every email we send about a back-in-stock notice or the newsletter has an unsubscribe link, and one click stops all further messages.
policies.tbd: These policy pages are placeholders while we finalize the details.
